title: finding(fields,a11y): an image, avatar or signature cell holding a `data:` URI names its `` with the base64 payload, so a screen reader reads kilobytes of base64 as the image's alt
body: Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction (class a, accessibility). Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it. The site is `readFileValue`'s `nameFromUrl` in `@object-ui/fields`, and `ImageCellRenderer`, which prefers that name over its translated `fields.image.imageAlt`. Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#8677 (PR objectui#10492). ⛔ Not graded and not routed: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's. ## Reproduction (the dev's census, relayed, ⛔ not re-run by the seat) On base `71a4a5335`, the cell census's data-URI row reads `alt='png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo='` for `signature`, `image` and `avatar` alike. ## Mechanism (source reading) `nameFromUrl` takes the text after the URL's last `/` as the file's name. For a `data:image/png;base64,…` URI, that is the MIME tail plus the whole base64 payload. `ImageCellRenderer` uses that name as the `` alt ahead of its translated `fields.image.imageAlt`. `SignatureField` stores `canvas.toDataURL('image/png')`, so EVERY real signature is a data URI, and its cell's alt is kilobytes of base64. ## Reach Reachable today on any `signature` cell, and on `image` / `avatar` cells whose value is a data URI. PR objectui#10492 leaves it byte-identical (populated signatures keep the image renderer). ## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade) - The shape of the fix: `nameFromUrl` yields no name for a `data:` URI, so the translated `fields.image.imageAlt` fallback applies. ⛔ No change to stored values. - Seam: `renderer:readFileValue.nameFromUrl` → `renderer:ImageCellRenderer` alt. ## Dedupe REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18). `nameFromUrl` ⇒ 0. `data URI` near `alt` ⇒ 0. `base64` near `alt` ⇒ only PR objectui#10492. `imageAlt` ⇒ 0. Must-hit control `readFileValue` ⇒ 2 hits. Dedupe words: `data URI alt text` · `nameFromUrl base64` · `signature image alt` · `readFileValue data: name` --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
